subject.title: bug: withAllowedHostname only updates allowedHostnames, not hostnameAllowlist — breaks navigate with non-empty hostnameAllowlist

question: Should OpenClaw fix this by granting the selected loopback CDP control host across both SSRF hostname fields, or by passing a separate CDP-control policy into Playwright navigation/session helpers while leaving page-navigation policy strict?
rationale: The source mismatch is concrete, but the fix changes a browser SSRF boundary and current tests encode part of the stricter behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before relaxing it.

options.title: Fix CDP control policy only
options.body: Keep page navigation checks strict, but ensure Playwright/CDP connection and target lookup use the scoped CDP control policy so loopback control traffic cannot self-block.

options.title: Keep explicit operator allowlist
options.body: Require users with `hostnameAllowlist` to add the CDP host themselves and update docs/tests so that burden is intentional.

options.title: Fold into broader SSRF design
options.body: Leave this issue open behind the broader private-network confirmation and allow/block policy design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38931.

recommendation.title: Fix CDP control policy only
recommendation.body: Keep page navigation checks strict, but ensure Playwright/CDP connection and target lookup use the scoped CDP control policy so loopback control traffic cannot self-block.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the recent CDP host allowlist work and authored the shared helper refactor around the implicated policy path.
